task_summary: I am a database engineer. I need to modify the persistence layer to support future changes to the management of municipal reports. Before modifying the database, I need to understand the main data entities stored by the system, the relationships among them, and which information must be persisted throughout the lifecycle of a report. In particular, I need to understand how users, reports, locations, categories, states, state changes, internal notes, and notifications are related, and which parts of the application depend on this persisted information. | modify the persistence layer to support future changes to the management of municipal reports | persistence layer | The diagram must make clear the main data entities stored by the system, their relationships, and which information must be persisted throughout the lifecycle of a report.

selected_view.purpose: Code / Implementation Mapping View for database: architecture elements mapped to implementing types. Relations: implements or located-in. Do not: entire-repository class dump.
selected_view.diagram_language_rule: viewpoint agent chose plantuml: PlantUML can accurately depict the implementation mapping and relationships between architectural elements and their implementing types for AQ1, AQ2, AQ3, and AQ4.

required_information.need: architecture element to source file mapping

architectural_questions.text: What are the main data entities and their relationships within the persistence layer regarding municipal reports?

Which specific information within the persistence layer must be persisted throughout the lifecycle of a report, including users, locations, categories, states, state changes, internal notes, and notifications?
Where in the persistence layer are the extension points or modular boundaries designed to support future changes to the management of municipal reports?
Which parts of the application depend on the persisted information managed by the persistence layer?
